title: At the Iron Gate  (铁门重逢)

segments.t: 第六集紧接正午的庭院重逢。汉娜端着热茶走到大树下，凯勒布用那三句简单真诚的话打破了三年的坚冰，哥哥欧文开口的第一句话就让人眼眶一热。先完整听一遍吧。
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
现在我们放慢节奏，一句一句品味两兄弟冰释前嫌时的英语表达。
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
'原来那个“带着爷爷遗物的人”从头到尾就是你呀，凯勒布。' 系动词过去式搭配短语构成
was you all along
语气平静却带着一眼看穿弟弟心思的温柔。
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
'你好，欧文。谢谢你今天能来。' 凯勒布稳稳说出了汉娜教他的第一句话，其中
Thank you for coming today
真挚大方，一下子接住了重逢的气氛。
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
'我两秒钟就认出了明信片上你那工整的印刷体字迹。' 英语把一笔一画不连笔的工整手写体称为
block handwriting
寥寥几字道出哥哥对弟弟习惯的熟悉。
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
'等等，你明知道是我寄的，却还是来了吗？' 副词放在过去式动词后面组成
came anyway
表示“不管怎样还是来了”，惊喜之情溢于言表。
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
'我当然会来。你干吗要躲在一张神秘字条后面呢？' 毫不犹豫地回应对方时，句首用
Of course I came
语气笃定自然，瞬间打消了弟弟所有的顾虑。
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
'因为我怕你还在生我的气。这三年我很想你。' 坦白内心的顾虑与胆怯时，英语常用
I was afraid
后面直接省去引导词接宾语从句，听起来格外诚恳。
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
'嘴硬死撑了三年……老实说，弟弟，我也很想你。' 回应对方同样的思念时，只需在句尾轻轻加上副词说出
I missed you too
三年的隔阂在这一刻彻底融化。
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
'打扰一下，二位先生。热茶来了，温热的柠檬蛋糕马上就送到。' 餐饮服务中告诉客人点心随后就到，最地道的短语是
is on the way
字面意思是正在路上赶来。
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
'柠檬蛋糕？等等，她是怎么知道星期五柠檬蛋糕这件事的？' 表示听说过或知晓某件往事，动词后面常配介词构成
know about
准确表达对其中曲折的好奇。
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
'快坐下吧，欧文，脱掉你的厚大衣，看看这只蓝色行李箱。' 日常招呼客人脱下外套或鞋帽时，固定使用短语动词
take off
亲切自然地请哥哥安顿落座。
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
'那是爷爷木工坊里那只旧的深蓝色提包吗？' 名词所有格短语
Grandfather's workshop
指爷爷当年做木工活的工作间，一眼勾起童年的共同记忆。
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
'你们慢慢聊，想待多久都行。整个庭院都留给你们。' 请人不必拘束慢慢叙旧可说
Take all the time you need
最后再温和补上一句
is yours
尽显客栈待客的周到与分寸。 体会了这份血浓于水的默契，我们再按自然语速听一遍整场戏。
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
三年的赌气在热茶和重逢面前烟消云散，汉娜体贴地退回屋里，把安静的庭院留给了兄弟俩。接下来蓝色箱子就要打开了，一会儿见。
See you soon!
